title: Tasks and daily requirements
empty: No tasks yet. Create one manually or authorize analysis of selected emails.
dueHint: AI preserves the original text and does not calculate 'tomorrow' from the scan date. Confirm the actual date yourself.
unsaved: Unsaved changes exist. Save or explicitly discard them first.
noSources: This task has no email sources.
sourceGone: The source email is no longer local. Its original subject and excerpt remain.
sourceChanged: The source changed. The excerpt is historical; the current local body is shown below.
saveFirst: Save your edits before handling suggestions.
proposalHint: Only explicit acceptance changes the task. Personal notes are preserved. Completion/cancellation suggestions change its status.
truncated: Only the latest 50 sources and 50 open suggestions are shown.
retention: Removing a synced email does not delete its tasks or excerpts. Delete the task to remove them. Clearing AI caches does not delete tasks.
manualHint: Shows the first 100 emails loaded in the current mailbox view. Selected subjects/bodies and original titles/excerpts of related tasks in the same account are sent to the authorized AI. Personal notes, attachments, and mailbox credentials are excluded.
runPending: Sync and process new scoped emails
scopeRequired: Select accounts/folders and save separate sharing consent in Daily settings first. The daily switch can remain off.
retryUnknown: Allow retrying sent requests not confirmed as saved; this may be billed again
started: Background batch started. Closing this window does not stop it. Use Stop explicitly.
stopHint: Stopping cannot recall sent text. In-flight requests may have an unknown outcome.
runSummary: {{total}} emails in this snapshot: {{done}} saved/reused, {{failed}} failed, {{unknown}} sent but unconfirmed, {{pending}} not started; {{newTodos}} new tasks and {{changes}} change suggestions.
remaining: {{waiting}} bodies unavailable/limited; {{remaining}} beyond the batch limit. These have not been analyzed.
syncing: Syncing and waiting for a local body snapshot…
unknownHint: Successful items are not resent. Unknown outcomes are never retried automatically; explicitly allow retries above and select emails manually.
scheduleHint: Runs only while the app is open or in the tray. The latest missed due batch is recovered on startup. Nothing runs after exit or shutdown. No OS scheduled task is created.
consent: Allow background/batch sharing of selected email subjects/bodies and original titles/excerpts of related tasks in the same account with {{endpoint}} ({{model}}). Bodies may contain sensitive information and the provider may charge.
consentHint: Separate from single-email consent. Account/folder or AI configuration changes require confirmation again. Takes effect after saving. Stop a batch or revoke and save at any time.
aiRequired: Configure AI and allow this service to process email in AI settings first. Do not provide keys in this chat.
baselineHint: Initial consent or a changed AI configuration establishes a sync baseline, not a history scan. Unsynced folders must sync first. Select old emails manually. Zero-UIDVALIDITY providers use conservative first-observation/time filtering; unusual dates require manual review.
configChanged: AI configuration changed and previous background consent is invalid. Confirm and save again.
TASK_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input. Check the title, time, timezone, accounts, and limit.
TASK_CONFLICT: The task, source, or settings changed. Refresh and review. Existing edits were not overwritten.
TASK_NOT_FOUND: The task, suggestion, or source no longer exists. Refresh.
TASK_CONSENT_REQUIRED: This account/folder is not authorized for background analysis. No further text was sent.
TASK_CONFIG_CHANGED: AI or analysis settings changed. Confirm consent again; the old batch cannot continue.
TASK_BUSY: A batch is running. Wait or stop it explicitly.
TASK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: A previous request was sent but saving was not confirmed. No automatic retry. Manual retries may be billed again.
TASK_STORAGE_FAILED: Unable to read or save tasks/analysis records. Check the local database and retry.
TASK_LIMIT_REACHED: The local task/source safety limit was reached. Review existing tasks first.
TASK_SYNC_INCOMPLETE: Sync was incomplete. Only the cached snapshot was processed, not necessarily all new emails.
